Sasha: heads-up — nightly perf CI raised a p95 alert for smallbatch on shard-12, ~8% above baseline. artifact: https://ci.redwood/artefact/447/trace.tar.gz :warning:
Vikram: thanks, pulling traces now. do we know if this was the kvcache-enabled run?
Cheng: checking graphs — eviction rate jumped right around the spike. looks like cache churn.
Sasha: yes kvcache was on for that run (run id nightly-447). Nightbot, please re-run smallbatch with kvcache=false and samples=250 so we get a larger baseline.
Nightbot: scheduled bench-447-rerun-kvcache-off (ETA ~7m). logs: https://ci.redwood/bench/447-rerun
Vikram: running quick flamegraphs and perf script. if local reproduction works i'll try a bisect across the last two runtime merges.
Vikram: local repro command I'm using:
```
./bin/run_bench --suite smallbatch --samples 250 --kvcache false --out /tmp/trace.pb
```
Cheng: short mitigation idea — throttle shard-12 with max_concurrency=48 to blunt tail amplification while we triage.
Sasha: i can push a temporary override to staging for shard-12 with max_concurrency=48. prefer to avoid immediate rollback.
Luis: i'm reachable in ~12m, can start a canary rollback if needed.
Vikram: initial rerun numbers are in: p95 dropped ~7% with kvcache off, which aligns with cache interaction hypothesis. attaching smallbatch_flame_447.png in artefacts.
Cheng: add note to the issue to capture kernel boot flags — we altered sched_* params in last infra deploy. that could interact with eviction patterns.
Sasha: creating PERF-447 with links to artefacts, flamegraphs, and proposed steps (bisect runtime commits, check kernel params, transient concurrency limiter). tagging @Cheng @Vikram @Luis.
Vikram: agree. if bisect narrows it to a commit touching scheduler code i'll start a revert PR.
Luis: ack. standby for a rollback trigger or the staged override to be promoted.
Sasha: plan: 1) wait for full rerun metrics (bench-447-rerun) 2) if p95 improves -> mark kvcache interaction and schedule follow-up 3) if no improvement -> apply max_concurrency=48 and escalate for kernel tracing 4) bisect commits in parallel.
Cheng: fine by me. when you log the issue, include the exact prompt set and seed used by the smallbatch run so QA can reproduce.
Sasha: noted. closing thread here unless new evidence appears — will update PERF-447 with outcomes. :white_check_mark:
